# Eco-Kin archive / visual-data instructions

This repository is an Eco-Kin archive/support surface.

- The 125-ID Permanent Dex in `Dlomotion/Echohearts-Rebearth` is authoritative.
- Historical names, image labels, prototypes, mutation concepts, Shimmer/Blessed forms, and variants do not auto-create new species IDs.
- Preserve approved image identity and provenance; version corrections instead of silently replacing unrelated specimens.
- Route gameplay/runtime implementation to `Dlomotion/ECHOHEARTS-REBEARTH-BUILD-`.
- Preserve Vibrance, Density, Harmony, Purity, Anima-Link, Huma-Link where applicable, and the non-coercive Eco-Kin agency rules.
